messages.subject: error when running INLA
parts:
Hi, I just installed INLA on a new computer and tried to run some codes as before in R. It worked until calling inla(...) with the following error message:

Error in x[["Version"]] : subscript out of bounds
In addition: Warning message:
In FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
  DESCRIPTION file of package 'Rcpp' is missing or broken

Would anyone know what was happening? Many thanks!

Best,
Eridk

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] error when running INLA
parts:
The warning message says there is something wrong with the Rcpp package in your R installation, so I'd look at that before trying to run the inla code, as it appears you're running some inla code that uses that package.

R only displays warnings after the code has terminated, which is why the warning shows up only after the error message. So if you get an error and then a warning, often the warning indicates the root cause, and the error is just an effect of that.

Finn
